اخترطن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَرَطْنَ (iḵtaraṭna) /ix.ta.ratˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# اُخْتُرِطْنَ (uḵturiṭna) /ux.tu.ritˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# اِخْتَرِطْنَ (iḵtariṭna) /ix.ta.ritˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
